what: Each scattered photo cell turns at its own tempo, as if breathing — blur 10px·.9x·transparent, clearing at the 20% mark and holding until 60%, then growing to 1.05x as it blurs away (ease-in-out). The first length is 10~30s·delay 1~5s, random per cell, after one cycle it rests .5s, swaps to the next photo in the cell and repeats at 20~40s — so the hero is always slightly different

options.next: Length range from the next lap (s), default 20-40
options.[data-fx-part=shot]: Photos shown alternately inside a cell (with two or more they change each turn, one also works)

note: The tempo differs each time it opens, so the original and the copy can’t be compared at the same moment. With reduced motion, the last photo is shown as is
